title: Transport a composition structure along homotopies of all three edges
intent: Reduce the goal of transporting a composition structure (a 2-simplex) along homotopies of all three edges to a chain of three single-edge transports, each a small lemma closing with one horn filling, so the corollary is a three-step `Nonempty (CompStruct …)` chain rather than one large construction.

parent.name: transport_all_edges
parent.statement:
lemma transport_all_edges {f f' : Truncated.Edge x y} {g g' : Truncated.Edge y z}
    {h h' : Truncated.Edge x z} (hf : HomotopicL f f') (hg : HomotopicL g g') (hh : HomotopicL h h')
    (s : CompStruct f g h) :
    Nonempty (CompStruct f' g' h')

children.name: transport_edge₀
children.statement:
lemma transport_edge₀ {f : Truncated.Edge x y} {g g' : Truncated.Edge y z} {h : Truncated.Edge x z}
    (s : CompStruct f g h) (htpy : HomotopicL g g') : Nonempty (CompStruct f g' h)
children.closed_by: rcases htpy with ⟨htpy⟩; exact Quasicategory₂.fill32 s htpy (compId h)

children.name: transport_edge₁
children.statement:
lemma transport_edge₁ {f : Truncated.Edge x y} {g : Truncated.Edge y z} {h h' : Truncated.Edge x z}
    (s : CompStruct f g h) (htpy : HomotopicL h h') : Nonempty (CompStruct f g h')
children.closed_by: rcases (HomotopicL_iff_HomotopicR.mp htpy) with ⟨htpy⟩; exact Quasicategory₂.fill31 (idComp f) s htpy

children.name: transport_edge₂
children.statement:
lemma transport_edge₂ {f f' : Truncated.Edge x y} {g : Truncated.Edge y z} {h : Truncated.Edge x z}
    (s : CompStruct f g h) (htpy : HomotopicL f f') : Nonempty (CompStruct f' g h)
children.closed_by: rcases (HomotopicL_iff_HomotopicR.mp htpy) with ⟨htpy⟩; exact Quasicategory₂.fill31 htpy s (idComp h)

applicability.goal_shape: a structure transport goal `(s : R e₀ e₁ e₂) → R e₀' e₁' e₂'` given homotopies/equalities `eᵢ ~ eᵢ'` for each edge, where `R` is built horn-by-horn (here `CompStruct f g h`, a 2-simplex with spine `f`, `g` and diagonal `h`) and each untouched edge has a degenerate filler (`idComp`, `compId`)
applicability.use_when: the transports along the edges are independent, each a one-line horn fill `Quasicategory₂.fill*`; the goal is a `Nonempty (CompStruct …)` that can be threaded one edge at a time
applicability.avoid_when: an edge transport is a nontrivial construction rather than a single horn fill (then that edge is its own sub-decomposition); the transports interact so a later step needs more than one earlier output; the structure lacks degenerate fillers for the untouched edges; or the homotopies are stated in a relation that needs conversion first (as `HomotopicL` → `HomotopicR` does here via `HomotopicL_iff_HomotopicR`)

claims.claim: The theorem-scale shape has 3 direct child lemmas; the glue (parent site) is 10 lines and the three child sites are 4, 5 and 5 lines, each child's proof being one `rcases` plus one `Quasicategory₂.fill*` horn-filling line.
claims.evidence: site spans of the copied file: parent 574-583, children 545-548, 550-554, 556-560 (https://github.com/emilyriehl/infinity-cosmos/blob/89d7dc3ed861824535e540da489a46469dcc8e56/InfinityCosmos/ForMathlib/AlgebraicTopology/Quasicategory/TwoTruncated.lean)

claims.claim: The authors' blueprint `proof` for the corollary states the strategy verbatim: "Apply the three conclusions of Lemma \ref{lem:2-truncated-qcat-htpy-comp} one at a time to transform the given 2-simplex."

metrics.how_counted: line counts are the site spans (parent 574-583, children 545-548, 550-554, 556-560); 'children_closed_by_single_horn_fill' counts the three children, each of whose proofs is one rcases plus one exact Quasicategory2.fill31/fill32 line

consequences: The move creates one leaf per edge of the structure (here three) and a linear plumbing obligation: each step must open the previous `Nonempty` with `rcases` before applying the next lemma, so the glue is O(edges) `have`/`rcases` steps. If an edge's homotopy is stated in the opposite relation (here `HomotopicL` against the fillers' `HomotopicR`), the leaf converts it first via `HomotopicL_iff_HomotopicR`, which adds one project lemma below the children (the depth-2 chain). The chain has no side conditions of its own, but it relies on degenerate fillers `idComp`/`compId` for the edges not yet transported.
